title: LLMs Can Infer Political Alignment from Online Conversations
reasoning: The paper systematically evaluates the performance of LLMs in inferring political alignment across several topical categories, with 'Religion' being one of the most significant and highest-performing domains analyzed. This evaluation includes mapping specific religious communities and subreddits (e.g., r/atheism, r/Christianity, r/Islam) to analyze how LLMs respond to and process religious discourse to identify underlying values.
